knownBoundary: Default passive observation reproduces a selection-only 26 to 25 rollback between e keyup and r keydown while the draft is identical. All requested characters arrive in order, but later characters insert before the previous e, so exact single-marker insertion fails. The native writer cannot be identified from this normal trace alone.

fixtureReview.snapshot: inputSnapshot only reads value, selection and geometry
fixtureReview.defaultTrace: inputTraceInstall registers passive event readers, no method or property setter instrumentation
fixtureReview.input: one actual tap followed by one full adb input text burst; no programmatic caret positioning or paced/retry path
fixtureReview.assertion: preserves arbitrary tap insertion, checks one exact contiguous marker and all original draft characters; it does not require end-of-line insertion

productionReview.inputOverride: No onKeyDown/onKeyUp/onCreateInputConnection or TextInputDelegate override in shipped wrapper
productionReview.candidateExternalWriters: Official SDK TextKeyListener/shadow action handling and IME setSelection/composition callbacks remain candidates. SDK updateSelection delegates only notify IMM; it is not itself a DOM writer.

limits: Visible IME and stable 669 ms readiness exclude initial keyboard animation as the sole explanation of this specific occurrence, not all SDK/IME scheduling races.
Passing optional diagnostic runs do not fix this failing normal path and cannot replace formal acceptance.
Do not drop exact input checks, rewrite the draft, move the caret, disable the IME or pace/retry characters to convert this sample to a pass.
